notes: Start(7) as posted: Wise Advice, Twilight Is Upon Me, Insurrection, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Hidden Base, Rendezvous Point and 'System'. Several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.
Posted 'System' (the Hidden Base objective's starting system) names no card: kept as posted (UNKNOWN). The deck's systems are Kessel, Kiffex and Dagobah.
Posted 'Tant DB' dested Tatooine: Docking Bay 94 (read as a Tatooine docking bay; the strategy says to 'pull tant db' for Luke and Obi on the ground).
Posted 'Twileck' (Interrupts) kept as posted (UNKNOWN): Twi'lek Advisor is a Dark card and the Light side has no Twi'lek interrupt in 2000.

Posted 'grabber' kept as posted (UNKNOWN): Allegations Of Corruption is a 2001 Coruscant card; in late-2000 Light lists 'grabber' usually meant What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?, but the post does not say.
Wise Advice, Do, Or Do Not and Battle Plan are the Effects of 2000, not the later Defensive Shields.
